children: Ryman Hospitality announced a $1.20 per share cash dividend payable October 15, 2026.
Declared $1.20 per common share dividend to stockholders of record as of Sept. 30, 2026, payable Oct. 15, 2026.
Subsidiary RHP Hotel Properties will pay $1.20 per OP Unit to unit holders of record as of Sept. 30, 2026, payable Oct. 15, 2026.
Each distribution is treated under 29 CFR §4043.31(a) with respect to the Company’s frozen defined benefit pension plan.
These are fourth-quarter matching payments in FY2026 following $1.20 payments on Jan. 15, Apr. 15 and July 15, 2026.
